title: Rebuild the minimal verifiable core of Dc-Dev (basic phase closed)
scope: dc-dev (sole visible agent) -> triage -> experience-mode -> dispatch -> real worker -> result -> receipt

workers.role: performs the delegated task under bounded write-scope; the ONLY subagent

experienceModes.selector: resolved up-front per run inside dc-dev

rules.automatic: runs only within an approved scope; halts on risk/block/out-of-scope

triage.role: precondition gate — runs BEFORE experience-mode resolution (R5) and dispatch (R9)
triage.resolvedBy: R5 remains the authoritative fail-closed mode resolver; triage recommendation is advisory

green.match: pointwise fix / cosmetic / simple config (color, button, typo, single config value); single surface, bounded validation, no data/security/permission/architectural concern
green.recommendedDepth: shallow / minimal test set + minimal workflow

yellow.match: feature or multi-file change with moderate risk, standard flow; >=2 files or non-trivial logic; no security/data/permission/architectural ambiguity

red.match: architecture, security, data, permissions, or ambiguous scope

triage.ambiguity: asks exactly ONE human question and halts until answered; never auto-classifies

kits.role: dc-dev entry / boundary / result contract / experience-mode / triage gate
real SDK dispatch to dc-dev-worker + wiring + fail-closed + scope
receipt schema + e2e live + no-secrets + real-evidence + experienceMode

archivedOutOfScope: legacy cavekit-* / gentle-orchestrator / sdd-* (reference only, untouched)

dispatchMechanism.call: client.session.prompt({ id, prompt, agent: 'dc-dev-worker', subtask: true })
